analysis_summaries: The repository processes video frames for people detection using a COCO-pretrained YOLO11s ONNX model. Each frame is letterboxed to 640×640, converted to RGB, and normalized before inference. The decoder filters and suppresses overlapping predictions to produce labeled bounding boxes, including the COCO person class. The application also tracks detections and evaluates tracked people against zones, producing zone-status output.

analysis_summaries: This repository provides a single-image PPE object-detection sanity test using an ONNX YOLOv8 model. The application loads an image with OpenCV, letterboxes it to 640×640, converts it to RGB, scales pixel values, and runs ONNX inference. The model outputs raw bounding boxes and scores for Gloves, Vest, goggles, helmet, mask, and safety_shoe; the decoder filters predictions, applies NMS, and maps detections to image coordinates. It reports visible PPE detections, not missing-equipment violations. The supplied task is a video file, which this entry script does not process.
